description: Jesse Custer is a small-town preacher losing his faith--until he merges with a divine being called Genesis. Now he has firsthand knowledge of both Heaven and Hell and a voice that's automatically obeyed by anyone. Joined by an Irish vampire and an ex-lover, Jesse sets out on a mission to find God.

issue_title: How I Learned To Love The Lord
description: Jesse continues telling his history to Tulip, and when morning comes, his worst nightmares come true.
With all hope gone, Jesse has given up. Until John Wayne reappears to tell him why he has to keep fighting; Tulip is given a message from God.

issue_title: Until The End Of The World
description:
"All in the Family" concludes as Jesse seeks bloody, final revenge on his grandmother and her henchmen. But even a Jesse may be no match for the power of God...

Jesse has his power back and is determined to bring down his grandmother and her whole evil household.

The vampire Cassidy returns in part 1 of the 4-part ''Hunters,'' as two secret societies converge on Jesse Custer. One is The Grail, a clandestine order dedicated to preserving the world's greatest secret. The other is the Gomorrah People, a cult of carnal extremists led by the depraved Jesus de Sade.

Jesse and Tulip go to San Francisco to meet up with Cassidy; Jesus De Sade, the Lord of the Gomorrah People, plans a party; a conspiracy-within-a-conspiracy is uncovered.

Jesus de Sade wants his secret stash. Starr wants some relief. And Jesse Custer and Cassidy want some answers. Plus, the secret of the Grail is revealed!

Jesse and Cassidy discover the cause of Cass' girlfriend's death; Starr explains his conspiracy and gets a surprise; De Sade plans his party.

On the morning after his fateful back-alley rendezvous, a boiling-mad Starr is looking for revenge. Meanwhile, Jesse Custer and his crew crash in on Jesus de Sade and discover a party of positively Babylonian proportions...

Starr's search for Jesse, and Jesse's search for De Sade lead to the biggest, most hedonistic party on the west coast.

All hell breaks loose at Jesus de Sade's party, where the overindulgent host is getting more excess than even he bargained for. As Jesse and Cassidy rumble with Bob and Freddy, a pistol-packin' Tulip takes on Starr and a phalanx of heavily-armed psychotics in ""Hunters"" part 4 of 4.

De Sade's party ends in chaos; Cassidy and Tulip are captured by Starr, and The Grail makes a grave mistake....

In this epilogue to ""Hunters,"" the Grail thinks Cassidy is Jesse Custer...and their Messiah, to boot! Captured by Starr and his henchmen, Cassidy continues his masquerade and discovers new secrets about the clandestine order.

Starr takes Cassidy to Masada, the headquarters of The Grail - and The Grail's ancient plan is revealed, as is Cassidy's identity; Jesse and Tulip find out where Cassidy is and make plans to rescue him.

The secret of Jesse Custer's infamous cigarette lighter is revealed when a Vietnam War veteran relates the bloody tale of Private John Custer's stand at the notorious battle of Khe San.

Jesse meets one of the men his father served with in Vietnam - The Spaceman - who tells the story of how his father got the Zippo that Jesse treasures.

Notes:

  • Ranked #27 in Wizard Magazine's list of "100 Best Single Issue Comics Since You Were Born".

In "Crusaders" part 1 of 6, Cassidy wakes up to find himself the subject of an autopsy at the hands of The Grail! Meanwhile, Jesse Custer and Tulip O'Hare arrive in France to search for their captured friend, unaware of the forces aligned against them--foremost of which is The Saint of Killers.

The Saint of Killers is on Jesse's trail; Jesse and Tulip are in France, preparing to find Cassidy; Starr discovers that the thing he loves most has been ruined for him.

While Jesse learns more about his new powers, the Saint of Killers cuts a bloody swath through Sheriff Hugo Root's men. But that's nothing compared to the horror of Root's home life, or Cassidy's vampire appetites.

Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy are on the run from The Saint; we meet Sheriff Root's disfigured son; Cassidy's true nature is revealed!

Jesse and Tulip take on a Grail hit squad, Cassidy ends up more wretched than ever, and Starr's depravity takes a new, even more vile turn in part 2 of "Crusaders."

Starr calls in experts to deal with two of his most important problems, and finds success with each; Jesse tries to figure out how to keep Tulip out of danger, whether she wants him to or not.

The Saint of Killers makes his way across the ocean and Starr finds himself entertaining two extremely unwelcome guests--a very special little boy and Allfather D'Aronique, the unbelievably gruesome head of the Grail.

The Allfather comes to Masada, wondering what Starr has been up to; Cassidy is tortured by Frankie the Eunuch; Jesse slips away from Tulip, fearing for her safety.

Deep in the dungeons of Masada, something spooky is stirring. Elsewhere, Allfather D'Aronique reveals his master plan, Jesse hears the worst news in the world, and Starr gets just the first installment of what he so richly deserves.

Jesse makes it to Masada; Starr is found out by the Allfather, and tries to bring Jesse into his plan; the Saint of Killers arrives, and Hell follows with him.

The Saint of Killers arrives, but he's got a very interesting proposition for Jesse Custer and his friend in part 6 of the 6-part "Crusaders" storyline.

The Saint of Killers comes to Masada and agrees to spare Jesse so long as Jesse use the knowledge of Genesis to find out why the Saint's family died.

In the bloody climax to the 6-part ""Crusaders,"" Starr pulls off his boldest move yet while Allfather D'Aronique and his blessed child meet their fate and Jesse makes a last-ditch effort to save Cassidy.

Masada falls, between Starr's bombs and Jesse's talent for destruction; God leaves another message, this time with Cassidy.

Find out the shocking story of how Cassidy became a vampire in "Cry Blood, Cry Erin," a 2-part story set during the Irish Republican Army's 1916 "Easter Rising."

The story of how a nice young Irish boy named Proinsias in 1916 became the hard-living, blood-sucking Cassidy.

issue_title: To the Streets of Manhattan I Wandered Away
description:
In the conclusion of a special 2-part story chronicling Cassidy's early adventures in the United States, the vampiric buddy of Jesse Custer bumps shoulders with hard-drinking writers and free-loving hippies.

Cassidy continues to tell his story of how he spent the 20th century; pledges his absolute gratitude and trust to Jesse.

In Part 1 of a 2-part story, Jesse and Tulip are reunited in New York City, but nothing can prepare Jesse for what Tulip's about to do to him. And, many miles away, Starr finds the consequences of his recent actions very difficult to live with.

Starr heads to San Fransisco and is picked up by an annoying cab driver who blasts painfully irritating music. Starr shoots out the radio and tells him to just drive. Jesse (Preacher), Cassidy, and Tulip all meet up. Tulip takes Jesse to somewhere a little more private. She handcuffs him to a bed and leaves. Starr and Featherstone meet up and discuss where Hoover went and how Starr got the scar on his head. (From Jesse) Meanwhile, Tulip catches up with old friend Amy, where they discuss how Tulip found Jesse. Tulip later catches up with Cassidy where Cassidy drunkenly confesses his love for Tulip. She goes back, uncuffs Jesse, and the two of them go to sleep together.

Starr copes with his latest physical disaster, Jesse and Tulip attempt to reconcile their relationship, and Cassidy struggles to live with the results of his recent stupidity. Plus, Jesse's search for God intensifies.

Tulip tries to figure out how to handle Cassidy's confession, and begins to suspect that his promise to Jesse might have an ulterior motive; Starr tries on hats.

__

Our issue begins with Cassidy coming to grips with the fact he's the "biggest wanker in the entire world". The scene cuts to Tulip in bed with Jesse, laying there thinking about Cass's confession and explaining to Jesse why she felt so betrayed when he left her in France.

Meanwhile

Herr Starr begins trying on wigs. but decides to switch to hats when he realizes all the wigs look awful. Finally he finds a fedora of sorts which not only looks good but covers up the nasty scar from Jesse slitting his head open.

Elsewhere.

Cass, Jesse, Tulip and Amy all meet for a drink. Jesse gets up to have a dance with Amy while Tulip and Cass talk about his recent confession. Later on, Tulip and Amy leave to a more feminine place while Cass and Jesse get into a bar-fight of sorts.

Amy leaves and tells Tulip to call her if she ever needs her.

The book ends with The Saint of Killers off in the desert with few words left on his lips...

"War it is"

As our heroes head south for New Orleans, Jesse decides to take the angel's advice to heart. Plus, the triumphant return of one of PREACHER's most requested characters.

Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy head west, hoping to find the secret that's been buried in Jesse's head by Genesis; the return of Arseface!

issue_title: And The Horse You Rode In On
description:
As Sheriff Root and his hideously deformed son set out in pursuit of Jesse and Tulip, the vampire Cassidy faces the Saint of Killers. Meanwhile, angels have begun their own pursuit of the being that has merged with Jesse.

Cassidy leaves the group after revealing he's a vampire; Jesse and Tulip talk about their past and Genesis; Sheriff Root tries to recover his honor.

Jesse and his crew hit New Orleans on a hot Saturday night. Pale bloodsuckers creep from the shadows and a butt-ugly old favorite lines up his gunsights on Reverend Custer's head. And just what is that business with the photo of Cassidy all about?

Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy meet Xavier, an old friend of Cass' and a lord of Voodoo; Cassidy's history begins to catch up with him.

Cassidy's past starts to catch up with him, Arseface gets his big break, Les Enfants Du Sang make their move, and Jesse takes a step closer to discovering the truth about his strange power.

Tulip puts Les Enfents Du Sang in their place, and Cassidy swears he had no idea they were there; Cass tests his boundaries with Tulip anyway; Jesse gets ready for some voodoo.

Les Enfants Du Sang make their move on our heroes, but with Jesse in a voodoo-inspired trance, can Tulip and Cassidy hold down the fort on their own? Plus, a major reptile slithers onto the scene.

Jesse finally gets in touch with Genesis and learns the horrible secret of the Saint of Killers; Cassidy and Tulip have another little chat, and Cassidy loses his head to Les Enfants du Sang.

The conclusion of our heroes' New Orleans trip: with Cassidy in big trouble and Jesse trapped in a voodoo-inspired trance, it's up to Tulip to hold off a deadly assault by Les Enfants Du Sang. Plus, Jesse gets another piece of the puzzle about Genesis; Xavier gives Tulip a dire warning about Cassidy; and Arseface sets off on the path to superstardom.

Les Enfents du Sang make their play to get Cassidy and Tulip, and meet a series of unfortunate ends; Xavier warns Tulip that Cassidy is not to be trusted; Arseface sets out on a whole new life.

issue_title: Once Upon A Time (War in the Sun Part 1)
description:
Beginning a story that will change PREACHER forever. Our heroes go to Monument Valley, where Jesse plans his showdown with God. But Starr and the Saint of Killers have other plans for Jesse's future. ...

Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy head out to Monument Valley to prepare to tap the wisdom of the Natives - through peyote; Starr brings The Grail to bear and gathers his strength.

issue_title: You And Me Against The World (War in the Sun Part 2)
description: Jesse prepares for his spiritual quest; Starr gathers his army; Cassidy falls off the wagon; The Saint arrives....

issue_title: Come And Get It (War in the Sun Part 3)
description:
Events near an explosive climax in Part 3 of the 4-part ""War in the Sun."" Panzers forward! Starr springs his trap, Jesse takes his life in his hands, the Saint of Killers loses his sense of humor, and Tulip learns whether she can get by with just a pretty face--or if she'll need a heavy machine-gun too.

Jesse tells the Saint about his origin; Starr goes to war; the Army is outmatched.

issue_title: The Shatterer of Worlds (War in the Sun Part 4)
description:
The conclusion of the 4-part ""War in the Sun."" There are people who go too far. There are people who go way, way too far. There are people who go completely over the top. And then there's Starr.

Starr authorizes the last extreme measure against The Saint; Jesse sacrifices himself for his friends.
One month later - The world reels from the bomb at Monument Valley; Cassidy and Tulip are on the run; Starr is under the protection of the Chunt Brothers; Featherstone hunts for Starr.

Life turns into an even bigger bummer for Cassidy and Tulip, Starr sinks about as low as he can go (and that's saying something), and someone comes stumbling out of the desert.

Jesse is saved in the desert by a Man With A Mission, Johnny Lee Wombat; Starr endures the unendurable; Cassidy crosses a line.

Guns blaze as the first arc concludes! Jesse, Tulip and the vampire Cassidy face an explosive showdown with the Saint of Killers as Jesse learns the truth of what's going on in Heaven and embarks on a new mission of vengeance.

Jesse meets The Saint of Killers and learns about what happened to him; a great secret of Heaven is revealed; Arseface is set down the road to his destiny.

You-know-who takes center stage in "Arsefaced World." Things go completely down the toilet for everyone, except Arseface, who sings a merry little tune.

Arseface retreats into fantasy; Tulip gives in to Cassidy; Jesse finds them at the worst possible moment; Starr is rescued and starts working on revenge again.

issue_title: The Man From God Knows Where
description:
Still getting over the events from the previous arc, Jesse enters the southern town of Salvation and runs into a childhood friend. As he attempts to get some much-needed rest, the town's sheriff comes to him with an interesting offer.

Jesse finds himself in the small town of Salvation - meets an old familiar face and takes time to settle down. As sheriff.

There's a new sheriff in the town of Salvation, and he quickly comes to odds with the toughest player in the area: the Meatman, Odin Quincannon! And what shocking secret does Jesse discover about Jodie that irrevocably changes their relationship?

Odin Quincannon tries to show Jesse who's boss - with predictable results; Jesse and Deputy Daggett go shooting; much is learned about Jodie.

Learn the story behind Jodie's journey to Salvation, how she first met Lorie and her startling connection to the town's new sheriff. Heartbreak, horror and happiness come in a reunion that finally brings some light into the life of Jesse Custer!

Jodie's past is brought back to her, and Jesse finds his mother; Odin Quincannon discovers that Jesse is officially dead, so no one will miss him.

Odin Quincannon takes drastic steps to eliminate Jesse. Needless to say, Jesse Custer doesn't take attempts on his life lightly and storms the Meatman's castle for revenge! But even the sheriff isn't above the law in Salvation.

Jesse is reminded that dropping people from windows is not how The Law works; Gunther Hahn tells his story to Jesse; Odin Quincannon calls in specialists to deal with his problem.

Playing in the confines of the law for once, Jesse begins to properly settle into the role of sheriff of Salvation. However, he quickly learns that Odin Quincannon never backs down, after the Meatman brings in some outside help.

Jesse settles into his job as the new Sheriff of Salvation, and offers to fight for the town - if they'll let him; Quincannon calls in The Klan.

Cindy and Jesse confront the recently arrived Ku Klux Klan, and Odin Quincannon gets pushed further and further toward deadly desperation! The fan favorite series by writer Garth Ennis and artist Steve Dillon continues!

Jesse and Cindy take the fight to The Klan; Odin Quincannon realizes it's time to get serious.

Odin Quincannon's been pushed too far and now he plans on burning Salvation to the ground in retaliation. Jesse must confront the Meatman--before he loses everything he built in the town and those he cares about as well!

The town gears up for a final showdown against Odin Quincannon, who's willing to sacrifice everything for revenge.

This is it! The final confrontation between Jesse and Odin Quincannon! What terrible and disturbing secret does the Meatman hold? Can Jesse stop the diminutive madman and save Salvation in time?

The menace of Odin Quincannon is finally ended; Jesse ties up all his loose ends, gets ready to leave, and learns several new things.

Desperate for answers to the missing holes in his memory, Jesse heads to the desert after the events in Salvation and takes some peyote. The answers he receives come from God himself, which may not be a good thing for Jesse Custer.

Jesse finally takes the peyote he got in the desert; many things are revealed unto him.

issue_title: Say A Prayer For Seven Bullets (Naked City Part 1)
description:
In part 1 of the 3-part ''Naked City,'' Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy arrive in New York City, where a bizarre friend of Cassidy's may provide a clue to the whereabouts of God. NYC is also the home of a cop who wants to know more about the supernaturally powered preacher.

Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy go to New York City to get away from the law and to find some leads; the hunt is on in NYC for the Reaver-Cleaver, a vicious serial killer; Jesse works out the ethics of his Gift.

Jesse goes to Washington D.C. to talk to Spaceman about his father's Medal of Honor.

Notes:

  • Ranked #80 in Wizard Magazine's list of "100 Best Single Issue Comics Since You Were Born".

issue_title: Freedom's Just Another Word for Nothing Left to Lose
description:
After months of depression, Tulip finally walks out on Cassidy--but not knowing Jesse still lives, where does she go from here? Learn the origin of Jesse's Girl with a special two-part arc!

Tulip finally brings herself to leave Cassidy; we learn of Tulip's upbringing and early days with her father.

The early days of Tulip O'Hare continue as we explore the origin of the love of Jesse Custer's life. Learn how Tulip lost the most important person in her life...and how she eventually found a new one when she first meet Jesse.

How Tulip met Amy and overcame her hatred of guns; how she met Jesse.

issue_title: Too Dumb for New York City and Too Ugly for L.A.
description:
In a self-contained road-trip story, Jesse encounters a bizarre series of hitchhikers--including a couple of old friends--on his drive from Washington, D.C., to New York. Is a reunion with Tulip in the wings, or will Jesse's trip hit some major speed bumps?

Jesse drives back to New York City, picking up hitchhikers and wondering about how America can endure under the weight of all the dreams.

issue_title: I Built My Dreams Around You
description:
It's what you've been waiting for: Jesse and Tulip reunited at last. But Jesse's got a surprise in store for him, as Tulip tells him the dark truth about his old pal Cassidy and what he did to her over the past few months.

Jesse and Tulip are back together again! Tulip tells Jesse all about Cassidy, before and after Monument Valley; Amy hears the terrible tale of Joe Soap, but learns why she should still have hope.

Embarking on a search to unravel Cassidy's secrets, Jesse locates a mysterious acquaintance from his old pal's past. Meanwhile, Starr's woes continue with a possible challenge to his authority arriving on the scene in the form of the Grail Allfather.

Jesse starts looking into Cassidy's history and finds a woman willing to tell; Starr meets Eisenstein, who is looking for answers; Hoover makes his goal

issue_title: Smile Like the Gates of Hell
description:
Jesse digs even deeper into Cassidy's secret history and discovers a dark side to his friend he never knew existed. Starr acknowledges a fatal misstep in his power struggle for the Grail, and Arseface learns that his celebrity lifestyle has a downside.

Aresface's manager does everything he can to get his client's name in the paper; Jesse learns about Cassidy and wishes he hadn't.

Jesse finally hears the last of Sally's story on the dark history of Cassidy while Starr mounts an offensive again the Grail Allfather Eisenstein, all while Arseface must fend off an increasingly hostile public.

The terrible tale of Cassidy is finished; Starr tries to eliminate Eisenstein, with hilarious results.

issue_title: Dot the I's and Cross the T's
description:
Jesse finally meets up with Cassidy and their reunion is anything but hugs and handshakes. At the same time, Starr makes his final move against the Grail Allfather Eisenstein, but even if he wins, he just might lose.

Jesse and Tulip send Cass away and go off to complete their Quest; Arseface is on the street; Starr eliminates his opposition - but at what cost? Johnny Lee Wombat sees his dream fulfilled.

"Alamo" part 1 - the final arc of PREACHER begins here! For nearly five years, Jesse Custer has searched for the Supreme Being to take him to task for the world's ills. That time has finally come as Jesse's quest takes him to the angels for answers.

Jesse visits the angels for information; Starr deals poorly with his disfigurement; Cassidy wants to make a deal.

Jesse and company search for clues that will lead them to God, while officer John Tool--the unluckiest cop in the world--tries to track down the serial killer running amok in New York City. Their quests converge unexpectedly when the killer's identity is revealed!

Jesse and Tulip try to come to terms with their relationship as it stands; Si starts doing some research; Detective Tool gets a lead in the Reaver-Cleaver case, but his partner is nowhere to be found; Cassidy learns the truth about his old friend.

Jesse Custer's quest races toward its catastrophic conclusion as deals and pacts are made all around. Jesse confronts the Saint of Killers with a deadly proposition and Herr Starr, continuing to look worse for wear, sees a final chance to make his move. "Alamo" part 2.

Jesse understands the mind of God and tries to convince The Saint of Killers to help him; Starr sees his big chance.

Starr unveils his evil master plan and goes after his opposition within the Grail! Meanwhile, an old enemy makes ready to pounce on Jesse Custer and Featherstone makes a revelation that puts her heart on the line. "Alamo" part 3.

Starr finally deals with his opposition within The Grail; Featherstone learns a painful truth; Hoover has his chance at revenge; Tulip reminds Jesse of who she is.

Arseface finally gets everything he deserves in the town of Salvation! Meanwhile, as love begins to bloom, heartbreak erupts in the Grail camp. "Alamo" part 4.

Arseface finds a new home; Hoover gets his heart broken; Salvation is saved; Jesse thinks about second chances.

As the Grail camp prepares for the upcoming assault, Jesse makes a fateful decision regarding Tulip--one she won't be to pleased with--and has one last conversation with the Duke. "Alamo" part 5.

Jesse makes sure Tulip is out of danger and has one last pep talk with The Duke; a practical joke goes wrong for Hoover and Featherstone; The Grail stakes out the Alamo.

issue_title: If I Knew the Way I'd Go Back Home
description:
Betrayals abound as Jesse confronts his old friend Cassidy. As the two have a painful discussion of their fractured friendship, Tulip comes to know a different betrayal. At the Grail camp, Hoover and Featherstone have a talk of their own! "Alamo" part 6.

Cassidy tries to explain all to Jesse, who won't have it; Tulip wakes up; Featherstone and Hoover talk it over.

"Alamo" concludes on the High Noon to end all High Noons--from the mortal plane to the heavenly Kingdom above--as everyone gets their just deserts. Jesse and Cassidy come to blows and Tulip takes on the Grail!

Jesse and Cassidy have it out; Starr gets his revenge, but Tulip gets hers next; Genesis is released from Jesse Custer, and all that implies....

It's the day after High Noon and Jesse Custer's quest is finally over in the extra-sized final issue! Find out the ultimate fate of Jesse Custer, Tulip, Cassidy, the Saint of Killers and more as Garth Ennis's epic comes to a close.

Garth Ennis groundbreaking masterpiece reaches its shattering, potentially life affirming conclusion. Prepare for quite possibly the greatest single issue in comics history.

Naked City concludes as Jesse, Cassidy and Tulip the serial killer, and the secret life of supercop Detective Bridges sees the light of day...

Cassidy's friend Si is revealed as the Reaver-Cleaver, and has a plan to set up both Cass and Jesse for the crimes; Detective Tool finally does something right; Detective Bridges' secret is out.
While Jesse and Tulip try to resolve the issues of her past, Jesse's past catches up with him. Gran'ma is not pleased.
Given one more night together by Gran'ma L'Angell, Jesse tells Tulip everything about his past.

Written by Brian K. Vaughan (Lost, EX MACHINA), this is the saga of Yorick Brown - the only human survivor of a planet-wide plague that instantly kills every mammal with a Y chromosome. Accompanied by his pet monkey, Yorick searches for his lost love...and the answer to why he's the last man on earth.

Synopsis

A crazed woman tries to get a female police officer to help two dying boys. The officer refuses and puts a gun to her head. She explains that all the men are dead.

29 Minutes Earlier: Yorick Brown hangs upside down in a straight jacket in his New York apartment while talking to his girlfriend Beth. The two are separated while she enjoys time in Australia. He rambles about Elvis until Beth finally gets him to quit stalling and admit that he didn't get his latest applied-for job. He asks Beth to hold as he clicks over to pick up another call from his mother.

Yorick's mother, Representative Jennifer Brown, is blown off by her son when she asks about his last interview. She hangs up the phone and gets approached by Senator looking for her vote on an abortion amendment. She refuses and things get a little testy. He is called away to meet with the president about "355."

Yorick is back on the phone with Beth and she senses that he is nervous about something. He nearly tells her but gets interrupted by his pet monkey, Ampersand. He explains to her that the monkey came from a Boston organization and was supposed to help him with chores. Yorick tries to talk to Beth again but Ampersand turns on the television to a report by Christopher Emanuel from Israel.

In Israel, the reporter wraps up and watch as a female Israeli soldier fires rubber bullets at Palestinians. She orders them away but Christopher, seeing an angle for a story he needs, asks her to escort the news team in exchange for an interview. She reluctantly obliges and gives her name as Tse'Elon.

The conversation between Yorick and Beth continues: He admits that he is having a hard time getting out some days. She mocks his fear of the outside world.

Outside in the world, a secret agent drops in on Dr. Frozan Hamad in Jordan. Agent 355 wants to help the refugee doctor escape but is rebuffed. Dr. Hamad isn't afraid of sticking up for her ideals but Agent 355 explains that an amulet is what enemies are after. The doctor explains that the amulet around her neck is a worthless story, one that claims that if the amulet were to leave the country then bad things would happen. She is soon shot down and Agent 355 kills the attackers. She takes the amulet and flees.

Yorick begins rambling about how much he misses Beth. She stops him to tell him something.

In a Boston hospital, genetics scientist Dr. Mann asks for help in having a baby delivered. The doctor she sees first is a student from a class she had taught. He is shocked to learn that the baby is a clone. He is ethically opposed to helping deliver a clone but morally opposed to letting a baby die.

Elsewhere in Boston, Hero Brown, Yorick's sister, tries to get it on in an ambulance with her new firefighter boyfriend. He gets called out, however, and they promise to get together later.

Back on the phone, Yorick stops Beth from telling him whatever it was going to be and admits that he may have bought a little something for her. He bought a magic ring and proposes to her over the phone.

At that moment, his mother's assistant Darin dies, as does Christopher Emanuel and his news crew in Israel, Agent 355's male pilot in Jordan, Hero's boyfriend, and every male mammal on the Earth. Except Yorick - who awaits Beth's answer - and Ampersand.

"Cycles" reaches its explosive conclusion with a sibling's madness, a firefight with a stolen helicopter, and a mysterious Russian who bears urgent news. All this, plus a truly startling development from Earth's orbit.

Because of Hero killing Yorricks friend in issue #9, he has a gun to her head. They exchange words, and Yorrick can't pull the trigger on his own sister. So he gives the gun to the women of Marrisville and lets them decide what to do with the Amazons. Yorrick and the now awakened 355 have a heart to heart, while she gives him a haircut. The big reveal, is that we find out where there are other men.

While riding another train, our travelers come across a Russian lady trying to reach Kansas where she believes her countries only living cosmonaut will land. He has been trapped in a space station with two American astronauts, one female and another male.

Meanwhile the astronauts plan their decent, and their eventual landing, including talking about precautions against the plague that wiped out all the other men, and their biggest problem, the aging fuel they have to use to land.

The now all female Israeli army is on what they consider a "wild goose chase" and are loosing patience with the person supplying information about Yorrick. In a fit of anger the leader "Alter" demands the identity of the informant.

Our story opens with Yorricks Mother talking on the radio to Alter, the leader of the Israeli Army. We find out that she was good friends with Alters commanding officer when he was alive. That she discovered bad things about the "Culpepper Ring " ( of which Agent 355 is a part Of ) and she thinks her son has been kidnapped. Alter reveals her agenda for searching for Yorrick, she actually does want to kidnap Yorrick, so Israel will have the only living male, to continue their nation. Natalya reveals the reason why the astronauts are landing in Kansas and not Russia as planned, Apparently not all of the nuclear power plants were shut down and some had melt downs, making the landing spot too irradiated to be safe. In space the two male astronauts get into a fight over a suspected sabotageing of one of their suits.

The story opens with the astronauts releasing their ship from the space-station it was attached to, so they could begin their descent. Our three heroes, along with the Russian Natalya, find the secret military base that the astronauts are supposed to land near, and they begin to prepare for their arrival, and possible quarantine of the males. Alter the leader of the Israeli army makes her play to kidnap Yorrick, a firefight ensues, two of the Israeli's are killed yet Alter gets away with Yorrick. Agent 355 uses one of the dead soldiers radios to tell Alter that if she returns Yorrick, 355 will trade the astronauts for him.

The book opens with Alter not believing Agent 355 about there being two male astronauts about to land near them. That is until 355 confesses her love for Yorrick. Interested yet still suspicious, Alter orders her copter to land, and she makes plans with Agent 355 for the exchange.

This does not sit well with Natalya who feels Agent 355 has no right to barter the life of a Russian cosmonaut, 355 tells her she made all of her story up in order to get the Israelis to return, and they begin to prepare for the upcoming battle.

Back at the helicopter, Yorrick tries to convince the lady soldiers that Agent 355 was making up her story about the cosmonauts, which only makes Alter think that there are two men who are going to fall out of the sky. She sends two of her soldiers to follow the Americans, while she prepares to blow the spaceship out of the sky.

When that goes wrong, Alter orders her soldiers to kill the Americans, but 355 had set Natalya up as a sniper and after a few shots her soldiers give up. With the help of her second in command, Alter is also captured.

Unfortunately it may be for nothing, when they do arrive at the space capsule they find it on fire with all three astronauts inside.

Alter tries to destroy the spacecraft but she's stopped by Yorick and Sadie. Nevertheless, the vehicle explodes with only one survivor, Ciba. Later is revealed that she is pregnant leaving a little light of hope.

New storyline.What might art and entertainment be in a world without men? The performers of the Fish & Bicycle Traveling Theater Company and a monkey with a knife wound may hold the answer.

In This issue we meet a theater troupe, who travel the country to give the women entertainment. They are practicing a version of The Pirates Of Penzance when a woman from a near by town comes up to them and asks if they could preform some continuations of the soap operas they used to watch.

In the middle of the night a little girl who is traveling with the troupe hears a noise that sounded like a monster. While standing guard the women begin chatting about reasons the men may have died, when all of a sudden, they hear the noise also.

After looking around they find a hurt Ampersand, and they take him back to their tent to patch him up. When they do they discover he is male. Thinking it is a sign they decide to write a play about the last man on earth. As the chapter comes to an end we see what looks to be a ninja spying on the troupe.

The book opens with The Theater troupe from the last issue rehearsing their play about the last man on Earth. After rehearsal a couple of the actresses are taking Ampersand for a walk when the young woman who asked them to perform soap operas comes up to them. She is not happy with their new subject, and after being blown off , leaves in a huff. Ampersand begins to make noises and we see that the ninja is still following them.

During the play that night the ninja begins talking to her employer, we find out that she is following Ampersand. She is told to only use violence if she can keep the number of casualties down.

Seeing that all of the actresses but the two watching Ampersand have left the ninja drops down ready to make her kill. A fight distracts her followed by a gunshot. She decides now isn't the time and leaves.

The gunshot came from a disguised Agent 355 and Yorrick. They came to find Yorrick, yet the actresses are reluctant to give him up until Agent 355 tells them that Ampersand is actually an expirimental Hermaphrodite.

Part 1 of the new 3-part story "Safeword," featuring the debut of new cover artist Aron Wiesenfeld. The last man on earth and his companions travel to Colorado, hoping to find medical attention for ailing pet monkey Ampersand. After an explosive encounter with a posse of female marshals, the group takes shelter with a retired agent of the mysterious Culper Ring. Will this alluring woman become Yorick's most valuable ally...or his greatest enemy?

The book opens with Yorrick having a dream that he is Dorothy, Agent 355 is the Scarecrow, and Dr. Mann is the Tin Man from Wizard of Oz. Soon however it returns to where we left off. Yorrick is trussed up, while Agent 711 is dressed in Dominatrix gear.

She imediately calls him gay, yet not in such a polite fashion. He of course denies it but after a few jokes, she gets fed up and beats him. Forcing a confession of something that happened to him when he was a little kid. After that she asks about his first Heterosexual experience. When he is reluctant to tell her she drugs him and he becomes very forthcoming.

She doesn't buy it, and gives him a viagra. He gets angry and begins to joke and insult her. She gets mad and presses her Psycological advantage until he breaks down and says, " I want You"

When a mysterious plague kills all male life on the planet, what do women do with the billions of corpses? Yorick Brown discovers the horrific answer as he travels to Washington in search of his Congresswoman mother. And which unexpected female has just been named President of the United States?

Synopsis

Two months later, Yorick walks outside in a gas mask and cloak to hide that he is a man. He has Ampersand in a carrier. A garbage truck careens out of control and Yorick barely avoids getting hit. A woman hops out and apologizes and turns to assessing the damage done. She sees that her cargo has fallen out; Yorick is surprised to see that she is hauling dead men. She explains that she hauls the bodies in exchange for cans of food. Seeing the carrier, she stoops down and opens the door expecting to see a dog. Ampesand jumps out and immediately rips the mask off Yorick's face.

In Virginia, Agent 355 busts down the door of a house in which Margaret Valentine sleeps. Agent 355 informs the woman, the current Secretary of Agriculture, that her title has been updated to the President of the United States. Margaret can't believe it but Agent 355 assures her that it is so.

Yorick is looked up and down (and his nethers verified) before the girl handcuffs him to the truck. She intends to sell him after she finishes loading the rest of the spilled bodies. Unfortunately for her, Yorick knows how to escape from that brand of handcuffs. He makes his way to the White House to find his mom.

Inside, Jennifer Brown sends home a Secret Service agent and thinks she is settling in for a quiet night. However, Yorick surprises her from behind and she flips him over before realizing who he is. The two play catch-up and Yorick explains his theory that he was saved by a magic ring he had bought. He then tells his mother that he is going to Australia to find out what Beth’s answer is to his proposal. Mrs. Brown puts that plan on hold and tells him about Dr. Alison Mann, a woman that may be able to work on a clone to get the population restarted. Just then, gunfire takes out a window.

The sudden admission of desire from Yorrick takes Agent 711 by surprise, she climbs off of him leaving him bewildered. She tells him it isn't what he really wants, she tells him she needs him to know there are things he can't control and takes her to her hot tub. forcing the drugged Yorrick into the water she brings up that she had read 355's journal and brings up each time Yorrick revealed himself. Every time he denied it, or tried to rationalise it she would dunk him, After a few times she gets him to admit that he did want to commit suicide, but when he had the chance he couldn't pull the trigger. With a quick "Goodbye Yorrick Agent 711 pushes his head under water, and he at first accepts it. After a quick vision though he realises he does not in fact want to die, and forces himself loose of her grip. He runs out but stops before he leaves and she tells him it was all planned as a suicide prevention. That it was her idea and hers alone, and 355 had no idea about it. The next day Dr. Mann 355 and a healed Ampersand comes back and the trio head off. The book closes when a group of women dressed in Burkas, come into 711's home, they ask about an amulet 355 is carrying, and when it looks like 711 is about to draw a gun on them they open fire.

issue_title: Widow's Pass: Part One of Three
description:
This issue opens with our three heroes walking through a desert road. They come across some dogs chewing what looks to be human bones. They come across a road kill yet to be buried, when a young woman comes out from nowhere brandishing a gun yelling at them to get away from the bodies. 355 quickly disarms the girl but the young lady says she was trying to save their lives not kill them.

After recognizing that Yorrick is a dude, she invites them too her place, so they can fill their canteens and tell the story. While there, we find out a militia has set oup road blocks, and are not very patient with outsiders.

During an argument about what to do, Dr. Mann acidently lets slip that she had created a cloned daughter, not a son as she has been telling the other two.

She storms out in a hufff, rather than talk about it. Later that night Agent 355 comes into Yorricks room. She can not find Dr. Mann on the premises. The book closes as we see Dr. Mann has decided to confront the militia to let the trio pass.

issue_title: Widow's Pass: Part Two of Three
description:
Dr. Mann has decided to go out and make a deal with the Arizona militia, a bunch of women wanting to carry on in the posts of their husbands brothers and fathers. She asks them if her and her friends could have passage in return for medical assistance for two girls shot in a recent firefight.

This offer offends the leader of the group who was a nurse, and she hits Dr. Mann in the face with her gun. When Dr. Mann doesn't go down, she makes it a lesson to her daughter to keep hitting until they do.

Back at the gas station, Agent 355 has an idea of where Dr. Mann went off to, and she decides to go after her. Before she leaves she hands Yorrick a gun, in spite of his protests.

Agent 355 leaves and Yorrick and the mechanic "PJ", start talking she says she wants to have kids, Yorrick gets wide eyed but she tells him not with him, and thinks someone somewhere will figure how to do it.

Back at the Arizona Militias campground Dr. Mann is getting the hell beat out of her. Apparently the militia is now being run by a bunch of conspiracy theorists who have decided that Dr. Mann works for the government, and is beginning phase two of wiping out all life on the planet.

The leader sends her daughter out to check on P.J. , in the meantime, Agent 355 sneaks into the tent Dr. Mann is being held in and kills the woman beating her.

While Agent 355 is untying her Dr. Mann says more about her clone, and apologies, they are about to leave when the leader comes in and yells for her troops. Agent 355 puts the gun to her head, but instead of shhoting she knocks her out.

As two of the soldiers come in Agent 355 cuts ones eye out, and knocks out the other. She turns to see The leader holding a knife to Dr. Mann, threatening to slit her throat if Agent 355 doesn't stand down.

Back at the garage, Yorrick and P.J. are sharing some beers.When the wild dogs outside begin to bark. P.J. grabs her gun and runs out to check what it is, telling Yorrick to stay put. He pulls out the gun given to him by 355, and hides in the garage when he hears a gun shot.

The book begins with P.J's point of view when the gunshot occurred at the end of last issue. She runs out to see why the dogs are barking, she sees one of the Arizona militia standing there with a rifle, and yells at her to get off her property. The girl turns and accidentaly shoots P.J., showing no remorse the girl yells at the dying P.J. that was your fault, it's all on you. In the garage Yorrick was watching through a window. The gunshot makes Amperand squeal, and it attracts the girls attention. goes to the garage to see what made the noise and ends up getting the drop on Yorrick. Back at the militia camp, we find out they have been toruring Agent 355 and Dr. Mann. When they are done, they drag them out to a firing squad, but before they get a chance to kill them Agent 355 comes up with an idea for escape. In the garage, Yorrick turns to the girl holding a gun on him. He asks why she shot P.J., when she denied any blame, he raises the gun toward her they both fire. When Agent 355 and Dr. Mann return, he decides not too tell them about his part in the girls death. They decide to leave. The book closes, at the Oldenbrook facility, where the female astronaught was saved. it is discovered she had a baby with one of the astronaughts. The child was born and HE is doing fine.

issue_title: Tongues of Flame, Part One of Two
description:
For some reason it seems Yorrick is out walking about on his own. He comes across a church inside is a flight attendant named "Beth", which just so happens to be the name of his girlfriend in Australia.

The two of them open up to each other and give a sort of confession. Yorrick tells about how he had killed a girl in Arizona, and Beth tells how she was a flight attendant, and was in the air at the time.

Her plane was going down and she tried to land, it crashed and killed all but three others. Out of guilt she brought the corpses to the church cemetary and buried them, since then she has decided to stay and become the caretaker.

After their confessions they Yorrick finally gives in and for once enjoys a perk of being the worlds last man.

issue_title: Tongues of Flame: Part Two of Two
description:
After consummating their relationship, Beth and Yorrick are talking in the pupit of the church, when an arrow flies in through a window. The Amazons have arrived. Thankfully only three of them. They threaten to burn down the church but Beth talks them out of it. Then the leader of the little tribe threatens to kill Beth if she does not renounce God.

Yorrick shows up, putting on a show as if he were God, scaring away the Amazons. When it is all over, Beth decides to stay at the church, telling Yorrick to find "his" Beth in the Australian outback.

The book closes on Beth in Australia, where her and her friend are kidnapped by Aboriginies.

The book opens with a very young little Hero leading her younger brother Yorrick through a field to a statue with a hood over it's head. She starts talking to it, making as if the statue is yelling at Yorrick which makes him cry.

Cut to, she's fifteen at a college party and has he first sexual encounter

Cut to : At the dinner table Hero discussing her plans to be a paramedic.

Cut to : Hero's reaction to the plague

Cut to: Her first meeting with Amazons, and meeting the leader Victoria for the first time.

Cut to: Hero in the womens prison at Marrisville

Cut to : She meets her mother the congresswoman, who sends her out to find Yorrick.

cut to The Oldenbrook facility. Hero sees the male baby for the first time and we find out the programming Victoria had laid on her hasn't gone away completely. As she contemplates killing the child.

Part 1 of the 5-part "Ring of Truth." At long last, Yorick, 355 and Dr. Mann make their way to San Francisco to find out what caused the plague. But Yorick's unbalanced sister Hero and the mysterious Setauket Ring have also made their way west - and they all have their sights set on the last man on Earth!

The book opens and we find out that Yorrick did buy the engagement ring he has been wearing around his neck, at a magic shop.

In present time Agent 355 is allowing him to have some fun running up and down the court at a basketball game, in front of a large crowd of women, dressed as a team mascot.

We see Hero looking for Agent 355 and her brother at a massage parlor.The cashier is reluctant to give any information until Hero pulls a gun. After she gets the information Heroleaves and we see that the ninja is now following her.

While walking home Yorrick and Agent 355are confronted by the Burqa wearing women who shot Agent 711 a few issues ago.. They are after something called the amulet of Helene, that 355 grabbed in issue one.. A fight breaks out during which Yorricks ring is torn from around his neck. Our two heroes make their escape on a passing trolly car and we find out the ladies in question are members of a splinter group from the Culpepper ring that 355 belongs to.

Back at Allison Manns lab, 355 tells her they have to leave, but Dr. Mann protests saying she is days away from finding out why Ampersand and Yorrick survived the plague. Yorrick says " my ring" the women turn to look at him, and he begins to bleed out.

"Ring of Truth" Part 2 of 5. As Yorick fights for his life, Dr. Mann and Agent 355 attempt to figure out why he survived the plague and whether the mystical Amulet of Helene played any role.

The book opens in a fever dream with Yorrick and Beth running through a spacestation, with an order to kill as many "men" as possible. All the while Earth is on fire.

Dr. Mann and Agent 355 are watching over a very sick Yorrick, and Dr. Mann tells 355 that she has to get Yorrick his ring back. Not something 355 wants to do considering that it is now in the hands of three very skilled assassins.

We next find out that Hero is now in San Fransisco looking for her brother, she is still being haunted by the voice of "queen" Victoria leader of the Amazons. So much so that the ninja following her thinks she is talking on a radio.

Agent 355 crashes in on the Sektaut ring, ironically enough while they are discussing how to find her. We find out the importance of the amulete of Helene. They agree to meet later at a local ballfield for an exchange.

At the hospital Dr. Mann is treating an awake but woozy Yorrick, when she hears a noise that draws her away from her work.

At the ballfield, 355 hands over the amulet, and the Sekt says they will only give her the ring if she joins them. Fed up Agent 355 walks away, but before she gets into the dug out she is pistol whipped. Hero has arrived, and is pointing a gun straight at her head.

Part 3 of the 5-part "Ring of Truth." With Yorick near death and Dr. Mann frantically trying to save him, Agent 355 meets with the fearsome Setauket Ring and Yorick's sister Hero in a desperate attempt to get Yorick's engagement ring back. However, while 355's away, Mann makes a startling discovery about Yorick...

The story opens with Dr. Mann checking on a noise she heard in the last issue, only to have Ampersand jump onto her head. Although we do see that the ninja is right out side of the labs window. Back at the baseball field where Agent 355 was meeting with the Setauket ring, Hero has just pistol whipped Agent 355, and accuses her of kidnapping her brother. Her use of the word brother of course surprises the members of the Setauket. Back at the lab, Yorrick has woken up again and he and Dr. Mann have a heart to heart about recording what has gone on with them the past two years. At the ballfield Agent 355 tries to calm Hero down, but she is not willing to accept 355's word, considering she followed a trail of corpses to find her. Including 711's corpse. This news upsets 355 and she attacks the Setaukets. And once again back at the lab, Dr. Mann finally figures out why both Yorrick and Ampersand survived.

Trapped inside an impenetrable bunker, Yorick Brown struggles to rescue his Congresswoman mother from a murderous posse. Meanwhile, Culper Ring operative Agent 355 risks her life to protect the first female President of the U.S., and the news that a lone male has survived begins to leak out...

Agent 355 is on the road with the new President. In washington, the wives of the dead Republican Congressmen are laying siege to the whitehouse to forcably take thier husbands seats. The Israelis find out about Yorricks existance.

Synopsis

Miles outside Washington D.C., Agent 355 and new President of the United States Margaret Valentine begin walking due to the unresolved traffic snarl that occurred when the men died.

At the White House, Representative Brown looks out the window and sees some of the wives of dead Congressmen. She explains to Yorick that the women want their husbands' seats and plan on holding the White House hostage. She leads him down to a fallout shelter and locks him in. Senator Cavanaugh finds Representative Brown and the two head out to start a dialogue with the angry women. Yorick immediately begins devising a way out of the bunker.

Outside, Representative Brown approaches the women and sees that they have taken a guard hostage. The women demand their husbands' seats and Rep. Brown denies them since they still live in a democracy. Ms. Stahl makes her case but is cut short when the woman holding the guard prisoner slips and shoots the guard in the head. Another guard reacts and kills the woman. This sets Ms. Stahl off and she shoots back at the guard. The fight ends when Agent 355 rolls up with the new president in a garbage truck. A political discussion ensues but gets interrupted when Yorick appears. (He had used a fire to override the bunker's locks.)

President Valentine takes Yorick and his mother, as well as Agent 355, into the Oval Office and decides that Yorick cannot stay in one place, as it would be too risky. She okays the move to have him find Dr. Mann and sends Agent 355 with him just in case he tries to head off to Australia to find Beth.

In Israel, Tse'Elon (new Chief of the General Staff) receives a phone call from the United States. A person on the other end reveals that a man named Yorick Brown lives.

Part 4 of the 5-part "Ring of Truth." It's a dysfunctional family reunion when Yorick is reunited with his sister Hero. Will they continue their deadly rivalry, or has the ex-Amazon seen the error of her vicious ways? Plus, a mysterious ninja, a monkey and a shocking revelation that'll turn the series on its ear!

Okay so Yorrick and Dr. Mann are talking about what saved Yorricks life, it takes a couple of pages here because of Yorrick having to keep asking Dr. Mann to dumb down her explanation. She does and the explanation does not make Yorrick happy. Not too put to fine a point on all of this, but it was not Yorrick or anything he did that kept the two alive. It was Ampersand. When Hero and 355 return Yorricks frustration boils over and he lashes out at Hero, hitting her, when he accidently hits Agent 355 he apologises and leaves. 355 follows him and explains that Hero is a changed woman and he should trust her. Back in the lab Dr. Mann has given Hero A sedatve so she could fix her wounds, While under, Hero has a dream of "Queen" Victoria of the Amazons, and finally not wanting to hear anymore, kills her. Back in the lab, the ninja outside the window sees that Dr. Mann is all aone with Ampersand so she goes in and takes the one creature that could cure the plague.

The 5-part "Ring of Truth" reaches its shocking conclusion! Just when Dr. Mann finally discovers the answer to how Yorick and Ampersand survived the mysterious plague, an unforeseen adversary swoops in and steals a major key to the possible cure. But could the thief be working for someone close to the trio?

The book opens with Agent 355 preparing to go after the ninja using the same tracking device Hero was using to follow Ampersand. Before she could leave they find out Yorrick has already gone out. 355 catches up to him, but he refuses to go back to the lab. After hearing Ampersands screaming 355 and Yorrick meet the ninja on the San Fransisco Bridge, where a fight breaks out between 355 and the ninja. Unfortunately for our hero, things do not go so well, but Hero shows up in the nick of time with a rather large gun and saves the day. Later back at the lab, and after a nights rest, Dr. Mann has decided to go looking for Ampersand, and Hero is going to go home, but first stop off in Kansas to deliver some of Ampersands feces, to the geneticists. The next day our three heroes are on the road again, or at least at the docks, where they find out the ninja girl had charted a boat to the same city Dr. Manns family is from.

Finally leaving the United States, Yorick and his companions begin an important quest for a missing friend. Yorick joins a ragtag band of female sailors on a thrilling voyage overseas, but what dangerous new threat lurks deep beneath the Pacific?

Our three heroes booked passage on a ship bound for Japan. Well two of the heroes, Yorrick was hidden in a crate so he could escape and join them later, but the women running the boat laid the crate on it's top. The only part that Yorrick had rigged. So 355 is trying to bust him out when a woman comes in to get her out of the cargo hold. 355 starts to fight her but a very big woman grabs onto her and throws her into the crate revealing Yorrick. 355 and Yorrick are brought to the captain who decides Yorrick should stay in her cabin to be safe. In the meantime, The ship apparantly has a spy, who has killed the radio girl, and sent a signal to an Australian submarine.

Part 2 of the 4-part "Girl on Girl." The swashbuckling adventure continues on board an old cruise ship rechristened The Whale, where the last man on Earth meets an alluring young captain. As romance blossoms in some cabins, betrayal, deceit and murder flourish below deck.

Yorrick walks in on 355 and Dr. Mann making love, but before they can deal with it they hear a scream from outside. 355 and Dr. Mann go to find out what is wrong. The spy who killed the radio girl is captured. It is explained that some Australian submarines have been searching the waters to rob them of their cargo. As the women who run the ship prepare for what is coming 355 and Dr. Mann talk about "what happened" between them.

Part 3 of the 4-part "Girl on Girl." When questions of loyalty arise from the all-female crew of The Whale, Yorick must decide whether his allegiances lie with his old companions or his new mate, who happens to be captain of the potentially mutinous ship.

The book opens with a brief origin story about the captain of the ship. It tells how she grew the opium in America and decided to sell it to other countries. The scene returns to the brig and we find the story is being told by the spy, to Dr. Mann. That is when one of the ships crew pulls a gun on Dr. Mann and admits it. They have also captured 355 and are about to put her into a cell also. Meanwhile in the captains quarters, the captain and Yorrick are about to "get Busy" when there is an alert. The sonar has picked up the Australian Sub. The captain leaves her quarters, but soon an escaped 355 Dr. Mann and Rose ( the spy ) come in. Before they find weapons though, the captain returns with a rather large gun herself. She has ordered depth charges dropped onto the sub, and tries to explain that her drug running is actually helping the world. When a torpedo from the sub hits the ship, 355 disarms the captain, and the ship begins to sink.

The explosive conclusion of the 4-part "Girl on Girl." The good ship Whale makes its final stand against the crew's heavily armed pursuers, and countless women meet a watery grave. Will any of Yorick's companions survive? Plus, a woman from Yorick's past makes a startling reappearance.

While trying to escape the sinking ship, our now four heroes, run into a little bit of interference. Instead of fighting head to head with a force that outnumbered them, Rose shoots a fuel tank causing an explosion, and making the ship sink faster. Agent 355, Rose and Dr. Mann all find their way to a life raft, but before he gets on Yorrick releases it so he can go and find the captain. He tries to talk her into coming with them, she refuses and knocks him out. When he awakens the ship has sunk and he is in a life raft next to a surfaced submarine.

Series co-creator Pia Guerra returns for a special stand-alone issue that finally reveals the whole story behind Yorick Brown's long-lost true love, Beth Deville. As Yorick risks his life to travel halfway around the world in search of this alluring young woman, Beth must survive her own trial by fire.

The book opens Beth, is tied to a tree unconsious, while a couple of aboriginies are talking about what to do with her. One is convinced she is there for a very important reason. She spits something in her face that is supposed to take her on a spiritual journey, and Beth dreams. Cut to : Beth and Yorrick talking in a library after his roommate broke up with her. Their first connection. Cut to : Her in the Australian Outback, after the plague hit, discussing a theory on the population boom. Cut to : A halloween where Yorrick has promised to never leave her. Cut to : Meeting his family for the first time, Hero warns her that Yorrick will drag her down. Cut to : A dream of the time she tells Yorrick she is going to Australia. It then gets weird as Yorrick is getting kidnapped by a giant Ampersand. Beth turns into a superhero and flies up to save him. She does, and he tells her. I'm Alive. she believes it.

The last man and his companions finally reach Australia in Part 1 of the 3-part "Paper Dolls." As he searches Sydney for his long-lost girlfriend, Yorick encounters a dangerous new adversary who threatens to jeopardize more than just this reunion.

The issue opens with a reporter in Australia reporting on a rumour of a male sighting, and trying to find a confirmation. The scene changes to Yorrick arguing with the women in charge of him and the submarine he is on. Since they are docked at Australia, he wants to leave the sub and look for Beth. Agent 355agrees to give him 24 hours to look. They find the office Beth was working at, and see a message on the wall warning her to leave, when 355 and Yorrick are attacked.by drug addicts. Agent 355 quickly beats them, but once again Yorrick is revealed. While they are walking back, the reporter from the beginning of the story fires a taser at 355, she goes down, and the reporter makes Yorrick strip so she can take a picture of him.

How has the world of media changed since the onset of the mysterious man-killing plague? Yorick Brown finds out the hard way as he and his companions encounter a tenacious journalist dedicated to exposing the story of the century...by any means necessary.

After being knocked out last issue 355 wakes up to find Yorrick in his underwear. They deduce that the woman who took his picture was a reporter, and figure they need to stop the rumor of a mans existence, in order to prevent a war.

The startling conclusion to the 3-part "Paper Dolls" storyline! Love is in the air as two cast members make the connection, and Yorick continues his desperate search for his fiancée Beth. But when 355 risks her life to stop a tabloid journalist from exposing Y to the world, could it put the kibosh on cupid?

We open this issue to find that Dr. Mann and Rose, the new member of the team, have hit it off nicely. Nicely enough to earn this book it's mature readers label. Dr. Mann invittes Rose on their quest to find Ampersand. In the meantime, 355 is fighting with the reporter, and they go over the balcony. At the last moment 355 is able to save both of them, and the reporter gets away. Not before Yorrick lifts her travel pass though. They meet up with her at the airport and manage to find out that she knew where Beth usually hung out. After more than a few words, they get the information and decide if Yorricks picture is going to be taken, it's best that it happens in the gossip rag this reporter works for. They go off searching for Beth, but when they get to her last hang out, they find that she had a dream that Yorrick was alive, and went to Paris to find him. Back on the sub, Rose is meeting with her captain, and we find out that she is a spy the captain is trying to infiltrate our favorite trio with. The issue ends with Yorricks mother looking at the naked pictur of her son in the gossip rag. Alter, the israeli soldier, shows up and quickly shoots her

In this emotional issue, Yorick joins hundreds of women at a famous monument to pay tribute to all of the men who died in the Plague. But when a pack of violent female extremists interrupts this memorial service, the last man on Earth may end up joining his fallen brothers...

Agent 355 is given the mission to protect Yorrick on their Journey to see a bio-engineer, whom we met in the first issue. We meet the Amazons, a group of militant women who want to wipe out all remnants of their "male oppressors," which includes the last man himself. Yorrick's sister Hero returns.

Synopsis

Currently: Yorick gets manhandled by a gang of women.

An hour ago: Yorick and Agent 355 walk the streets of Washington D.C. on their way to Boston. Yorick senses Agent 355's anger at being his bodyguard and the two have a quick heart-to-heart. They determine that they need to find a motorcycle to wend their way through the broken down cars when Yorick hears singing. Agent 355 points him to the Washington Memorial. He distracts Agent 355 with Ampersand and sneaks off to the memorial to "pay his respects."

Yorick meets Rose and the two mourn the passing of so many great bands. Amazons show up and begin defacing the monument. Yorick stands up for men and reveals himself. The Amazons begin beating him. He fights back but is easily overcome. Agent 355 steps in (after having watched for the last ten minutes) and liberates Yorick. The Amazons flee and leave motorcycles and Yorick claims that it was all part of his plan. One of the lingering Amazons overhears that the duo is headed to Boston.

This Amazon woman goes to her leader and confesses her failure. The leader, Victoria, forms a hunting party and asks for someone familiar with the Boston area. Yorick's sister Hero steps forward.

It's been months since Yorick Brown left the United States, but in this special stand-alone issue, we revisit the many women the last man has left behind ? as well as a stunning development that will no doubt send shock waves through the unmanned world!

This is the story of Hero, Beth and a letter. Hero is on her way back to the lab in Kansas, but on her way she stops by the church Yorrick met a woman named Beth in. Funny thing though. Beth and Yorrick seemed to have concieved a child. Hero and Beth are talking about it, and what to do, when the church is attacked. Apparently, these nuns have heard rumours of a pregnant woman, and think it is an immaculate conception. They want to take the child, so he can grow up to be a priest, and declare it okay for women to be priests.

At last, the long-awaited origin of Agent 355, loyal protector of the Last Man on Earth! In this special stand-alone issue, the secrets of the mysterious Culper Ring and its most famous female agent are finally revealed.

This issue opens in the middle or maybe even at the end of a storyline. We see Dr. Mann and Yorrick run out of some woods yelling about some cannibles. Cut to : The origin of 355 Scene 1 : Her father is a tailor, and is giving her a bit of a tailoring history lesson. Scene 2 : As a little girl, she is being told her whole family died in a car wreck. Scene 3 : A teenager at school, some kid uses the N word to her, and she beats him with a ball bat. This sparks an interest from some government agency. Scene 4 : She is being trained for the culpepper ring. And is told how every part of her is a weapon, and she should not over look biting. Cut back to : Agent 355 getting ready to fight some cannibles.

This special stand-alone issue explores the past, present and future of Ampersand, the long-lost pet of the last man on earth. How did this male monkey end up with Yorick Brown, and where has the animal been since he was kidnapped by a mysterious Japanese assassin? Questions, answers and of course, monkeys abound!

scene 1 : Ampersand is in a lab getting injected with a "formula" one doctor tells his assistant that the monkey should be shipped to Dr. Mann

Scene 2 : We find out that Ampersand accidentally got switched at customs with a helper monkey.

scene 3 : Yorrick and Ampersand first meet

Scene 6 : Ampersand is dreaming. He is protecting an egg from birds on a beach. when the egg hatches it is Yorrick.

Scene 6 : Ampersand is with the ninja, she is talking to him and threatening him. Ampersand escapes into Japan

The last man and his companions finally reach Japan in search of Ampersand, Yorick's long-lost pet and the key to mankind's return. They're one step closer to learning who or what killed all the other males, but how many of Yorick's friends will live to hear the answer?

We join our heroes in Japan, The four main characters decide to split up. The Australian spy Rose and Dr. Mann are off to check a laborotory run by Dr. Manns mother, and 355 and Yorrick decide to go to Neo Tokyo. In a small pet shop, an old lady is standing behind the counter when a young girl walks in. She asks about the monkey that is sitting behind the lady. After the old lady tells her it would cost six million yen, the young lady draws her sword, and kills her. After checking the monkey and finding out it isn't Ampersand she makes a call to her superiors. 355 are walking down a Tokyo road having a conversation about how real relationships are built on mutual hatred, when they come to the place they were looking for, whose door looks a lot like women parts. Dr. Mann and Rose are walking down a trail discussing their relationship. When they come across The laborotory it is burning to the ground. Back in Tokyo, 355 and Yorrick thought it would be safer to enter the building through the back door, so Yorrick is picking the lock. When they enter, they here a voice,, when they turn there is another man standing there.

The epic "Kimono Dragons" story arc continues! Hot on the trail of Ampersand the monkey, Agent 355 and Yorick make a startling discovery in Tokyo, while Dr. Mann and her new girlfriend are confronted by a figure from the doctor's past.

The book opens with Hero and the Beth Yorrick impregnated finally reaching the Hot suite. Back in Tokyo, 355 has drawn a gun on the man who surprised her, yet he does not seem to react to her threat. They quickly discover that he is just an android, yet while they are examinating it, a woman hits 355 in the head with a chair. The two fight until Yorrick stops the fight by threatening to break the androids neck. Dr. Mann and Rose are looking through the remains of the burned down Lab. They are able to surmise that it was caused by a burning rat, and that her mother is not in the ashes. Rose asks if she knows of somewhere else her mother might have gone. We see Dr. Mann figuring out where her mother might have gone through a pair of binoculars with a parabolic microphone. The ninja has been watching the two of them and listening to everything they say. She seems pleased that Dr. Mann may know where her mother is. Back in Tokyo with Yorrick 355 and the ex cop who is now a pimp for an android. The cop starts talking and she gives us a little back story with what has happened with her, and more important, that the Tokyo crime industry has been taken over by a Canadian pop singer by the name of Epiphany, who is now in possesion of Ampersand. They decide that the best way to get to Ampersand, is to try and trade Yorrick, but 355 has a suspicion that Yu is working for Epiphany. We meet Epiphany, she is lounging around in her lengerie, very disappointed at Ampersand for not being more fun than he is. When she finds that she has no more cocain, she tells her second to cut off Ampersands penis and sell it for the drug. Dr. Mann and Rose have reached her mothers other laborotry, it's a green hose, and as Rose is stopping to smell the roses, she gets a sword through her stomach, courtaesy of Dr. Manns mother.

As Yorick and Agent 355 risk everything to save Ampersand from a bizarre new enemy inside a Tokyo skyscraper, another member of the last man's crew comes to terms with the blood on her hands.

The President and her Secretary of Defense are talking about defending the border states from the Mexicans., as they walk towards Secratary of the interior Browns office. Unfortunately when they arrive they find her dead. Shot twice. Agent 355 and You are getting ready to go get Ampersand, apparently by packing tons of weapons. After saying goodbye To 355 Yorrick talks to You and asks her to do something that not even 355 would consider doing. Dr. Mann is now holding a critically injured Rose in her armsas she is yelling at her mother. Her mother apologises stating that she thought Rose was the woman who burned down her lab. The two doctors start to take care of Rose when Her mother says that she thought she would never see Allison again, considering her need to look after Yorrick. At Epiphanys tower, all of her lobby gaurds are entranced with the fact that a male had just shown up in front of them. You had placed her android outside and it drew there attention. As 355 and You arrived at the floor Epiphany was on, they killed the two gaurds there. This starts a fight that ends with A gun to you's head, and 355 holding a gun to a little girl. Unfortunately for 355, You turns on her and gives up Yorricks whereabouts. The two Dr. MAnns are working on Rose, Allison asks her Mother how she knows about Yorrick. Apparently, the President and her have been good friends for years, and she has kept up with information. It was The elder dr. Mann who told the President to send Yorrick to Allison Mann. Moreso to keep the Monkey away from someone specific rather than anything else. Back at Epiphany Towers, Yorrick has been captured and thrown into the room with 355. He tells her it is all part of a plan, but 355 begins to have a breakdown. She is finally fed up with all her job has made her do, and holding a gun to a little girls head, knowing she could easily pull the trigger was the last straw. Yorrick tells her about the time he killed the young girl in Arizona, and they decide it is time for them to have a long talk. Back at the Mann lab. Rose has woken up and confesses that she is a spy, Allison refuses to believe her, the last page we see the ninja has arrived and is about to hit Allison with the sharp end of her sword.

The search for Ampersand, the last man's missing helper monkey, comes to an unexpected conclusion, as Yorick and his companions make a startling discovery about the unmanned world.

The book opens with a heart to heart between Yorrick and 355. We find out that Yorrick has been ashamed to confess certain things to the women he cares for. That he more often than not just tells secrets to Ampersand. In the lab, The ninja, who Allisons mother calls Toyota,, has a sword at Allisons throat. She asks the elder Dr. Mann where is Ampersand. This sets Allison off, because she thought he was with Toyota. At Epiphany Towers, You is searched and let into the room with Epiphany. She offers her some heroine but You turns it down saying she only wants the monkey. When Epiphany doesn't live up to her end of the deal. Yorrick for Ampersand, You stabs the second in command with the heroine needle and takes her gun. In the room with 355 and Yorrick, we learn that 355 knew 711 was going to put Yorrick through the tests she put him through. They share a moment, that looks as if it could get intimate. Back at the lab, Allison has challenged the ninja to a sword fight. It doesn't last long. Back at the towers, Epiphany starts yelling slurs, but You has her malebot wired for sound, so all the girls hear everything. After they take car of Epiphany, You returns Ampersand to Yorrick. He and Agent 355 leave. Back at the lab. Toyota had just stabbed Allison through the shoulder pinning her to the wall. She tells Allison, that if she wants to see her mother alive and learn the truth about who started the plague, she will find Ampersand and bring him to Hong Kong, to her employer.

A stand-alone special issue featuring the art of Goran Sudzuka and revealing at last the "secret origin" of Dr. Allison Mann, loyal but cantankerous caretaker of Yorick. What event from this brilliant young scientist's past will effect the future of the entire planet?

The secret Origin Of Dr. Man Scene 1 : Present Day we see Dr. Mann leaning against a door, Yorrick is yelling from the other side. Dr. Manns hands are covered with blood.

Scene 2 : We see Allison Mann as a little girl. Her blanket has holes in it. Her Mother tells her a good way to get rid of the moths is to kill the males. Once the males die, so will the rest. Scene 3 : Allison still a young girl, walks in on her father and a woman who is not her mother. The woman says something to her that she takes as an insult. These two will not be getting along. Scene 4 : Allisons mom is telling her they are moving to America. She promises that while they are changing countries, that the new country will never change them. Scene 5 : Allison as a teen ager, all punked out, with a mo hawk smoking in front of Manns Chinese Theater. There she meets her first girlfriend Scene 6 : Then has her first sexual experience with her, in the front seat of a Yugo no less. Scene 7 : Her Father tells her they are moving from America. Allison doesn't want to. When her father asks if it is about a boy, Allison outs herself to him. He invites her to stay. Scene 8 : Her and her girlfriend break up. Scene 9 : She is now a professor, a student tells her that her father is close to creating the first human clone. He asks her what she thinks about the morality of such a thing. She asks him if he can keep a secret. Scene 10 : She is pregnant with her clones, yes there are twins. The assistant is giving pre natal care. They are talking about unforseen health risks. Scene 11 : Present day, Dr. Mann is blleeding profusely from between the legs.

The final and most important "secret origin" issue of the series reveals the untold story behind former Israeli Defense Forces leader. Alter Tse'elon. What drives this female soldier's hunt for the last man on Earth, and what will Alter find that could mean the end of Yorick Brown?

The secret Origin Of ALTER Scene 1 : Alter has The twins in Kansas hostage she is looking for Yorrick, so she threatens to kill one if the other does not talk. Scene 2 : She is a little girl, she is holding a gun.and playing army. Her older sister comes up to her and tells her all fighting is bad and life is sacred. Scene 3 : She is sitting by a tree at a camp.She meets a boy and they talk. She likes him so she waits for him when he says he will come back after his counsellor falls asleep. He never does show up. Scene 4 : The day after she is sleeping by the tree, a counsellor finds her and says she has to go back home something has happened. Scene 5 : She is at a funeral. It's her sisters. scene 6 : She is in the army, she stops a suicide bomber from entering the base. The suicide bomber blows herself up early. Scene 7 : She is in a meeting with a superior officer, he is interviewing her for a higher rank. Scene 8 : After the plague, we find out her real reason for joining the army. Scene 9 : The twins tell her where to find Yorrick, she tells them that she is not going to hurt him. There have been battles over who gets him, she is out to save him.

Yorick Brown and Agent 355 prepare for their ultimate quest to reunite the last man with Beth, while Dr. Mann travels to China to finally find the person or people responsible for the global gendercide.

Another issue that opens with a funky dream. This one has Beth warning Yorrick to stay out of Paris. Yorrick wakes up to find that Rose is the only one there. The two of them talk about the plans that were made while Rose was unconciious. In the Chinese market, 355 and Dr. Mann are talking about the recent events. 355 can tell Allison is holding something from her, when she finds out that Rose confessed to being a spy 355 runs back to their apartment. Leaving Dr. Mann at a time when she is starting to have pains again. In the United states, Hero is on a boat with Beth The Russian lady, and the two babies. Defending them against a group of Amazons who want to kill the baby boy. When 355 arrives at the apartment, she hears noises that sound like love making, Only to discover it is Rose and Yorrick egging Ampersand, and Bonny the female monkey on.
