After months of preparation, Darque rules the night! A sadistic soul-eater, Master Darque has come gunning for Jack Boniface — with an offer he can't refuse! Will Jack make a deal with the devil, or will New Orleans burn under Darque's spell? Plus, an old enemy returns from the grave!

Contemplating his nightly appetite for violence, Jack begins to feel that Shadowman is a seperate personality within himself. But Jack hasn't long to wonder as he is attacked by one of Master Darque's zombies. Taken captive, Jack is brought before Master Darque, who offers him his heart's desire if he will serve him. When Jack refuses, Darque leaves him to battle the savage zombie while the house burns down around them!

1st appearance:

- Sandria Darque, Sister of Master Darque

Death of Marty.

The sins of Jack Boniface are visited upon Shadowman! What dark deeds did Jack commit in broad daylight, and how will Shadowman clean up his mess? But as he digs for answers, Master Darque delivers a crushing blow that will forever change the status quo!

Escaping Master Darque's burning mansion, Shadowman heads for home. In his new costume, he goes to gather information on his adversary, Master Darque. Investigating Darque's tomb, he receives a warning from Darque's sister to "remember the day of his death." Soon after, Jack falls prey to Darque's "Blood-Runner" spell. He begins running and screaming, his life bleeding out of every pore!

Pushed to the brink of death by Master Darque, Shadowman is out for vengeance! With countless lives at stake, Shadowman tracks Darque to the swamps for a starlit showdown. Can Shadowman stop the dark master's horrific rituals – or will the souls of innocents be forever lost?

A new serial killer is stalking the streets and he's set his sights on Jack's new love! But when Jack discovers that this vicious killer has adopted a mask of his own, Shadowman will realize that his work isn't just dangerous... it's downright deadly.

Jack Boniface is hitting the road, but he'll soon find that you can't leave Shadowman's problems behind. Deep in rural Alabama, Jack is drawn to a pentecostal church that's being terrorized by demons. Can Shadowman extinguish their hellfire before it spreads even further?

1st appearance:

- Avery

Jack's tour of the USA continues and he's about to discover that he's not the only when a strange secret. When Jack encounters a enigmatic drifter with the power to summon the past, will Shadowman be able to survive the ghosts that come calling?

1st appearance:

- R. L. McNeely

Shadowman takes Manhattan! The Big Easy meets the Big Apple when Jack lands the gig of a lifetime. But this is one concrete jungle where it's not safe to play, even when you wield the power of the legendary Shadowman!

1st appearance:

- Carmen Ruiz

- Hwen Fong (Dr. Mirage)

New Orleans' new protectors are...Archer & Armstrong?! Valiant's mismatched adventurers have been drawn to the Big Easy by Master Darque, but to what end? Plus-- what secret of the Shadowman legacy is waiting for Jack in the backwaters bayou of Louisiana?

1st appearance:

- Leiland Paige

Deep in the bayou with Archer & Armstrong, Jack Boniface is going to have his demon exorcised! But when the force that drives him out into the night is gone will there be anything left of the Shadowman? And without Shadowman can they survive the Nazi servitors of Master Darque come to make the bayou a living hell!

Jack Boniface is living the dream and jamming with Aerosmith! But when one fan turns to the necromancy of Master Darque to make his dream of playing with the band come true, Shadowman will have to take the stage to save Steven Tyler from playing his last gig as a Bloodrunner!

Jack Boniface can't sleep, not since he was attacked and left for dead by a strange and lethal woman. When the moon rises and the world rests, something inside him awakens and the Shadowman is born again! But what is the source of this power –?and will it be enough to survive the killer called Samedi that stalks the New Orleans back alleys?

Puzzled by his recent nocturnal urges to seek and destroy evil, Jack is told by his housekeeper, Nettie, that he is inhabited by a powerful voodoo "Loa" that compels his behavior. Presenting him with a costume to wear as Shadowman, Nettie tells Jack that he must face the serial killer, "Samedi", out in the swamps! What follows is a savage battle, with the unarmed Shadowman defeating the axe-welding maniac!

A dream draws Jack Boniface back to the old homestead, where old secrets refuse to stay buried. Snake-handling preacher Josiah Torrent is back and the power of the Master is in him... Master Darque that is! Can Shadowman save his parents or will the secret they've kept from him destroy them all?

To save his mother's life Jack Boniface has sworn the services of Shadowman to Master Darque, and now it's time for Darque to collect! When Darque sends Jack sliding backwards and forwards through time he'll see the future he's inspired and the past that haunts him. But will the legacy of the Shadowman save him, or be his end?

1st appearance:

- Blister

- Calvin

Original color art (see pic below).

Shadowman is back in time and face to face with... Shadowman! And he's got a sword to Nettie's throat! Face to face with the past and trying to save the future, will Jack abandon his last chance at being with Elya to thwart Darque's master plan or will he stay lost in time forever?

Master Darque's time tunnel sends Jack back to 1890's New Orleans, where he faces the Shadowman of that era, Maxim St. James. Meanwhile, in the present, Dr. Mirage attempts to save both Jack and himself from the machinations of Darque.

(Continued from Dr. Mirage #5)

Against the forces of HATE! Jack is ensnared in a web of political hatred when he accepts an invitation to speak on talk radio. Tragedy, and a moment of blind rage, causes Shadowman to rethink his mission.

1st appearance:

- Rotwak
Jack hunts a murderer on the streets of New Orleans, but the only path to capturing the killer is inside Shadowman's dreams.

It's Mardi Gras -- and in the hands of Ishmael, these beads are deadly! On the trail of a thief, a mysterious cabal turns the tables and Shadowman quickly finds himself in an unusual position as hunter becomes hunted.

1st appearance:

- Marcia

- Papa Napoleon

- Ishmael
Shadowman has had a lead pipe rammed through his chest. While recovering from a sizable exit wound at the New Orleans State Hospital, Papa Napoleon sends Ishmael to finish him off.
As Jack Boniface attempts to rebuild his life, Shadowman steels himself for a confrontation with Master Darque.
Master Darque leads an army of the dead in battle against Shadowman. Driven to the brink of insanity, Jack's one hope may be the last man to wear the mask of Shadowman -- Maxim St. James!

Dark things haunt the nighttime streets of New Orleans, but they only fear one man-- Shadowman! When Jack's housekeeper, Nettie, tells him about the life-sucking Harbinger called Sosa, he vows that this is one monster that won't stalk the night for long.

Crime-lord Emil Sosa has the ability to suck out the life-energy of others, leaving only a burnt-out husk! And now he has his sights on the vigilante -- Shadowman. Capturing the night-roving hero, Sosa locks him in his basement. He is released by a maid, who's had enough of Sosa's perverse appetite for children. But Shadowman doesn't care why he's free, only that he can now eliminate this demon from his night!

1st appearance:

- Sosa (Sousa) the Soul-Eater
On the trail of a vicious drug pusher, another innocent learns Shadowman's secret identity. But there's more than one monster lurking in the dark of New Orleans.
Shadowman faces off against Darque's latest necromantic creation -- a soul-thirsty amalgamation of the dead called The Night Monster.

issue_title: In The Belly Of The Beast
description:
Consumed by the Night Monster, Shadowman meets a skeletal wise man from an Edwardian world within. Now that Sandria has achieved godhood, does she stand a chance against the beast, or must she risk sharing her divinity with a familiar foe?

1st appearance:

- Baron Zastrow

- Elwood

As the souls of the dead burst forth and revolt, the Night Monster's reign of terror comes to an explosive conclusion -- but another evil is waiting to rise from under the black channels of the Bayou.

1st appearance:

- Luis Rojas
A Colombian drug cartel has taken Nettie captive for her voodoo power! But will these corrupt men get more than they bargained for?! And will Shadowman be able to save the day?!
When an innocent bystander witnesses a horrific crime, it's Shadowman's job to protect her - before it is too late!

issue_title: Cinderella Blues - Part 2: Flames Of Rage
description: Will Shadowman be able to save his damsel in distress before it's too late?! And will he be able to take down the killer for hire called Ishmael for good?

What mysterious reason put Shadowman on a collision path with X-O Manowar? Will these two heroes see eye to eye or become mortal enemies? And when Aric loses control of the X-O Manowar armor can even Shadowman survive the night?!
With the help of a mysterious woman, Aric regains control of the X-O Manowar armor. But will Shadowman be able to regain the upper hand against the hideous Blister?!
Will Shadowman be able to find and defeat Blister's devious employer - Ishmael. But what plans could Nettie possibly have for this killer for hire?

When the night comes and the darkness inside Jack Boniface awakens, the only thing to fear is Shadowman! But when Jack's housekeeper takes him to see her spiritual advisor, he'll find himself exposed to an evil so dark that even he may not be able to escape.

Unity Chapter 6

Nettie introduces Jack to Paul N'Dour, a would-be Geomancer, who takes Jack and Nettie to a cypress tree in the swamps, bidding Jack to swim beneath it. Jack surfaces in the midst of the Unity Conflict! Led by the she-warrior, Elya, Shadowman saves Mothergod from Solar, wrongly assuming that he was the greater threat. But he is badly burned in the battle, and Elya watches over him, drawn to the brave stranger.

Shadowman finds the door to the Lost Lant (Unity).

1st appearances:

- Elya

- Mr. N'Dour
When a popular author becomes one of the monsters she so often writes about, can Shadowman save her from her fate? Or will she drink his life's blood?!
Shadowman is a wanted man! The police are looking to bring Jack Boniface in, the charge: of reckless endangerment of the citizens of New Orleans. Will he have to face the music for his alter ego?
Jack Boniface is on trial for the crimes of Shadowman! Is it time Jack finally hung up the mask?

"The End?"

Smilin' Jack is on the edge of the ledge when he decides to kill Shadowman. He can only think of one way to do it, and Shadowman fans will discover the answer to the question, "Can Shadowman die before 1999?"

Serve the demon, pay the price! Transported to a land beyond time and space, Jack falls hard for a native warrior named Elya. But when he learns the truth of what she's fighting for, he'll have to choose between giving into love or continuing his personal battle as the one true Shadowman!

Unity Chapter 14

Badly burned while rescuing Mothergod, Jack Boniface is nursed back to health by the soldier-woman from the future, Elya. Once they have fallen in love, she reveals to Jack that he is destined to die violently in 1999. Later, Shadowman battles Archer and Armstrong before discovering that he has been serving the wrong master. Jack finally realizes that Mothergod's plan shall destroy all Creation!

Jack Boniface returns from a battle beyond space-time to the Louisiana bayou, only to lose his lover in the process. But he'll also lose his housekeeper in the swamp's fetid waters if Shadowman can't save her from a backwoods cannibal family!

Returning from the Unity Conflict, Jack realizes that he has lost Elya forever. Worse yet, N'Dour has been killed and Nettie is nowhere to be found. Returning to his home, Jack is summoned by Paul N'Dour's wife, who informs him that a family of inbred killers living in the bayou is holding Nettie captive. But as black-hearted as these murderers are, they have never seen anything as fearsome as the enraged onslaught of Shadowman!

Death of Mr. N'Dour.

Long nights as Shadowman begin to take their toll on Jack Boniface. But that won't stop him from taking to the night to track down the pushers, fiends and grave robbers of the New Orleans night! But where will the trail of a mysterious deaths and missing friends lead the Big Easy's unstoppable sentinel?

The nightly excursions as Shadowman are beginning to take their toll on Jack Boniface. His tired and bruised appearance prompts Jack's friend, Marty, to offer him drugs. But when the night falls, the pain fades and Shadowman stalks Marty, looking to nail his dealer. What Shadowman finds is that Marty is associated with a mysterious figure in the New Orleans underworld, a man with Voodoo connections called Master Darque!

Appearance of Master Darque - dialogue only, not seen.

1st appearance:

- Clemenceau

- Marty

After a disappointing night on the stage, Jack gets an all-too easy chance at shutting down a major drug ring. But the odds quickly fall out of Jack's favor as the bust takes an unexpected turn ! Outgunned and outnumbered, Shadowman better hope he's not out of luck!

To bring down Marty's pusher, Jack sets up a drug deal. But Marty has already revealed that Jack is Shadowman to his dealer, Mr. Clemenceau, who in turn answers to Master Darque. Later, Jack and Marty arrive at a warehouse to find Clemenceau and his thugs awaiting! When they fail to capture Jack, Darque orders Clemenceau to run Jack down with his car. But Jack proves too elusive, and Clemenceau dies in a fiery wreck!

First appearance:

- Master Darque - Known as only the "Man in the Shadows".

Original color art cover (see pic below).

A sinister crime lord returns to haunt Shadowman with a deadly new set of powers! As Shadowman tears New Orleans part during an exhaustive manhunt, what damage will be done to his personal life? Plus, Jack makes a shocking discovery about his destiny!

Shadowman learns that the "Soul-eater", Emil Sosa, is back in business. Until he hunts down this child-murdering fiend, Jack will know no peace! Sosa anticipates Shadowman's first attack, and drives him off. Knowing he's not fated to die until 1999, Shadowman fearlessly attacks once more. When the battle is over, Sosa's mansion burns to the ground with Sosa trapped inside.

“I looked, and there before me was a pale horse! Its rider was Death, and Hades was following close behind him.”—Revelation 6:8

A mysterious techno-virus has been released on Earth, infecting 600 million people and turning them instantly into violent, monstrous engines of destruction.

The heroes of the DCU are caught completely unprepared for a pandemic of this magnitude and struggle to save their loved ones first…but what happens to the World’s Greatest Heroes if the world ends?

New York Times best-selling writer Tom Taylor (INJUSTICE) returns with a terrifying new tale and is joined by artists Trevor Hairsine (LEGENDS OF THE DARK KNIGHT) and Stefano Gaudiano (The Walking Dead).

Thirty years after Batman: The Killing Joke changed comics forever, Batman: Three Jokers reexamines the myth of who, or what, is the Joker and what is at the heart of his ongoing battle with Batman? New York Times bestselling writer Geoff Johns and artist Jason Fabok, the team that waged the “Darkseid War” in the pages of Justice League, reunite to tell the ultimate story of Batman and The Joker!

In this highly anticipated epic, learn why there are three Jokers, and what that means for the decades-long battle between the Dark Knight and the Clown Prince of Crime. In this powerful, emotional story, Batman, Batgirl, and Red Hood-all past victims of The Joker-work together to solve a mystery unlike anything they’ve ever faced before!
